- round 2: Photo Quality Assistant Callout [adoption, hint]: predicted +7.0%, measured +10.2% (p=3.3e-05), won

- round 3: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Placement [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +4.5%, measured +0.3% (p=0.826214), lost: no clear effect

- round 3: Path Decision Speed Helper Callout [choose_path, hint]: predicted +7.5%, measured -3.1% (p=0.01256), lost: worse

Previous lessons:
Fast-track adoption flows and moving sign-in after pet adoption were helpful.
Photo quality callouts, interactive tip carousels, and split-view path selection screens were helpful.
Spotlight layouts on the final welcome screen, background notification prompts, and account sync copy banners showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too high for initial flow changes and non-significant tests, but were too low for visual callouts, progress carousels, and path selection screens.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Preset fast-track adoption flows, photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, and split-view path selection screens were helpful.
Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, post-adoption certificate sign-in placement, and desktop diagnostic flows showed no clear effect.
Path decision speed helper callouts performed worse than the control.
Predictions were too low for visual callouts, interactive progress carousels, and split-view path selection screens.
Predictions were too high for flow restructuring, sign-in reordering, non-significant tests, and changes that worsened performance.
